card.statement: We construct realizations of quantum generalized Verma modules for $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_n(\C))$ by quantum differential operators. Taking the classical limit $q \rightarrow 1$ provides a realization of classical generalized Verma modules for $\mathfrak{sl}_n(\C)$ by differential operators. Keywords: Quantum group, quantum Weyl algebra, generalized Verma module. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification: 17B37, 20G42.
card.label: Abstract
